scope.S79-SOURCE: Add a bounded replaceable issuer-holdings client for the exact allowlisted Vanguard Advisors BND port-0928 latest-holdings endpoint, with disabled unsafe redirects, bounded timeouts/retries/streamed bytes/rows, strict duplicate-key JSON parsing and attributable provider/source/effective-date metadata.
scope.S79-RANK: Across only fixedIncome and shortTermReserves, parse exact marketValue and percentOfFunds values without float conversion; preserve negative rows and repeated names; exclude only all-economic-fields-blank placeholders; rank valued rows by descending exact market value with collection rank and source index as deterministic tie breaks; require the selected ten to have exact nonnegative percentages and publish only those ten plus their exact non-understating concentration.
scope.S79-FRESHNESS: Apply a 1,080-hour maximum age only to official Vanguard-derived BND top_holdings and top_10_concentration_pct based on the source effective date. Preserve existing configured freshness and cap for Yahoo and every other field/source; fetch time is never observation time.
scope.S79-INTEGRATE: Invoke issuer composition only when Yahoo BND holdings are unavailable, replace top_holdings and concentration atomically with one provider/date, and preserve schema-2 publication/retrieval/screening/construction/checkpoint/PostgreSQL/dashboard integrity without changing eligibility thresholds, sleeves or allocation.
scope.S79-OPERATE: Add deterministic large fixtures and bounded HTTP coverage, disposable real-store end-to-end coverage, ADR/architecture/runbook/iteration documentation, and fresh live source publication plus five-candidate portfolio verification.

non_goals: No global freshness or configuration-cap change; 1,080 hours applies only to the two exact Vanguard BND fields.
No imputation, zero-fill, publication of blank-percentage rows, net/gross residual inference, missing-as-pass behavior or use of fetch time.
No screening threshold, category-sleeve, allocation, ranking outside this source parser, universe member or alternate-fund change.
No broad scraper/browser framework, authenticated source, credentials, trades, brokerage writes or guaranteed-return claims.
No historical snapshot repair or rewrite.

invariants.I79-AUTHORITY: Issuer evidence is accepted only from the exact allowlisted HTTPS Vanguard Advisors host/path for curated BND port ID 0928. Both derived fields retain provider vanguard_advisors, canonical source URL and effective date.
invariants.I79-RANK: Every valued row has a bounded finite exact Decimal marketValue; negative values are preserved. Rank descending by exact market value across fixedIncome then shortTermReserves, using collection rank and original row index only for exact ties. Repeated names/CUSIPs remain distinct. Exactly ten selected rows must each have a bounded exact percentOfFunds in [0,100]; their exact percentage-point sum defines concentration and receives the existing upward binary64 conversion.
invariants.I79-PLACEHOLDER: A row is an authorized non-valued placeholder only when percentOfFunds, marketValue and faceAmount are all exactly blank strings. Such rows are counted/audited but excluded from ranking and publication. Any partial blank combination involving missing marketValue, or any selected row with blank percentage, fails closed. A blank percentage with valid marketValue is retained for ranking and causes failure only if selected in the top ten.
invariants.I79-FRESHNESS: Only the exact provider/field tuple vanguard_advisors plus BND plus top_holdings/top_10_concentration_pct uses 1,080 hours from the effective-date UTC boundary. Every other provenance uses existing configured max age/future tolerance. Publication and consumed-field screening share one pure resolver and expose the applied window.
invariants.I79-FAILCLOSED: Non-200/off-host/changed-path redirects, oversized/malformed/duplicate-key responses, wrong configuration/date bucket/collection/row types, unbounded/nonfinite numeric lexemes, fewer than ten valued rows, invalid placeholders, selected blank/negative percentage, stale/future issuer date, contradiction or provider failure produces atomic unavailable/source-error evidence and cannot partially publish or reach review/explanation.
invariants.I79-COMPAT: Issue #70 schema-1/schema-2 encoding, digests/fingerprints, immutable publication/retry and retrieval validation remain unchanged. Non-BND and complete-Yahoo behavior, screening thresholds and construction rules remain byte/semantically compatible.
invariants.I79-STATE: State remains JSON serializable and contains enough provider/field provenance for deterministic freshness recomputation. Diagnostics contain only fixed allowlisted codes/source/field attribution, never raw bodies, unexpected URLs, connection details or exception chains.

acceptance.AC79-1: A live-equivalent fixture with 16,300 scoped rows, 16,296 exact market values, four all-economic-fields-blank placeholders, 1,190 blank percentages and 26 negative percentages selects the same ten market-value-ranked rows, all with nonnegative exact percentages summing 4.90581, publishes only those ten and retains provider/source/effective date. The largest valued blank-percentage row remains below the tenth selected row and is not published.
acceptance.AC79-2: Table tests preserve negative rows and repeated names, prove cross-collection ordering and source-index ties, accept only the exact triple-blank placeholder, reject partial blanks/missing market value/fewer than ten valued rows/selected blank or negative percentage/nonfinite or overlong numerics, and verify no deduplication or imputation.
acceptance.AC79-3: Issuer BND fields pass exactly at 1,080 hours and fail immediately beyond; future dates fail. Yahoo and every other field retain the configured 120-hour default and 336-hour cap. CLI/API publication, evidence, screening, restored review, construction and dashboard agree and identify the applied window.
acceptance.AC79-4: HTTP boundary tests prove exact host/path/port identity, no unsafe redirect, bounded connect/read timeouts and attempts, streaming byte/row limits, duplicate-key rejection and sanitized failure with zero partial publication.
acceptance.AC79-5: Complete Yahoo BND holdings make zero issuer calls; unavailable Yahoo BND holdings invoke one bounded issuer path; another symbol never invokes it; holdings/concentration never mix providers and both become unavailable atomically on source/ranking failure.
acceptance.AC79-6: Derived fields round-trip through schema-2 JSON, Chroma, Neo4j manifest/fingerprint, hybrid retrieval, screening, PostgreSQL close/reopen and dashboard without drift; corruption remains rejected and schema-1/non-BND golden digests remain exact.
acceptance.AC79-7: While the official endpoint retains the verified live shape/date window, a fresh guarded publication and the user's five-candidate workflow produce an eligible BND defensive candidate and deterministic portfolio with no workflow error. External-state changes produce an attributable blocker, never a bypass.
acceptance.AC79-8: Focused parser/HTTP/Yahoo/research/publication/evidence/screening/construction/CLI tests, full offline and opt-in real-store suites, Ruff, formatting, strict mypy, workflow validation, evaluations, build, both Compose configs, diff check, independent review and visible live application verification are recorded with no required skips.

risks: Official response shape, order, size, cadence or accessibility can change.
Treating exact triple-blank rows as non-valued placeholders is an explicit user-approved source interpretation, not a completeness guarantee from Vanguard.
Market value and percent fields may diverge or selected rows may later lack percentages, requiring fail-closed rejection.
Repeated bonds, negative values and exact ties can be accidentally deduplicated or converted through float.
Field-specific freshness can drift between publication and downstream recomputation.
Large streaming responses can exceed finite time or resource bounds.
escalation_triggers: Live data contains a selected top-ten row without valid nonnegative percentage or an invalid non-placeholder missing market value.
Implementing issuer-only freshness requires schema migration, historical rewrite or global relaxation.
The HTTP stack cannot enforce streaming byte, redirect and timeout bounds through an injected interface.
Publication and downstream freshness cannot share the same deterministic resolver.
Unresolved concurrency, integrity or provider-composition ambiguity appears.
Inherited finite budget cannot complete required real-store/live evidence.
